On Wed, Aug 18, 2027 at 09:25 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Rishi/Vivek — forwarding an urgent customer report (GreenWave).

Quick update from runtime triage: around 08:17–08:35 PDT we saw a short increase in queue-depth for the rw-instruct-3b fleet that correlates with a client-side workload pattern (a sudden burst of long-sequence batched calls). Observations: 

- Autoscaler did not add pods quickly enough because the short-term token-per-second spike matched our burst tolerance window; scale-up delay ~45s.
- Batching subsystem increased batch sizes due to prefix similarity (many requests share the same prompt header), which increased individual request tail latency under load.
- We also saw an uptick in retries from some SDK versions which amplified queue pressure.

Immediate mitigation we can push (5–20 min): 
1) Reduce batching max batch size for rw-instruct-3b to cap per-batch processing time (can be pushed as route override).
2) Temporarily lower burst tolerance/accelerate scale-up for GreenWave's routing tag.
3) Ask customer to downgrade SDK retry behavior (or we can silence client-side retries at the edge).

I'll coordinate a config roll and monitor the p95/p99. If that doesn't help in 30 minutes we'll consider temporary partial throttling of new sessions.

- Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

- We're on SDK v2.4.1 and have aggressive retry on network timeouts. We can change that if you think it helps.

Please proceed with your mitigations; the job is now paused but we need guidance so we don't trigger again. We need the endpoint stable by tomorrow morning.

-Sam

Subject: Re: Spike in p95/p99 today — urgent — action plan and exec summary

Hi Sam / Alicia,

Appreciate your patience while we worked the issue. Summary of what happened and what we did: 

1) Root cause (short): a burst of long-sequence batched requests from GreenWave combined with larger-than-expected automatic batch formation and a delayed autoscaler response, which produced queue accumulation and elevated p95/p99. Retries from SDK v2.4.1 amplified the load.

2) Actions taken (Aug 18, 08:55–09:20 PDT):
- We pushed a route override that reduces max_batch_size for rw-instruct-3b for GreenWave traffic (immediate p95 improvement observed).
- Accelerated scale-up policy applied to GreenWave routing tag to shorten scale-up window.
- We recommended and validated temporary SDK retry tuning on your side (reduced retry backoff; paused automatic retry for idempotency errors).
- Added short-term request admission control to limit incoming concurrent sessions while preserving in-flight requests.

3) Current state (Aug 20): metrics remain steady; target p95 restored to SLA range but we're keeping mitigations in place until your tomorrow morning run. We will revert route override gradually after 48 hours of stable telemetry.

4) Next steps / ask of GreenWave: please test your scheduled job in a controlled ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) tomorrow morning and share telemetry. We'll schedule a 30-minute postmortem sync to review tuning and long-term options: prefix-aware batching tweaks, adaptive batch timeouts, and a dedicated reserved pool for high-volume jobs.

If you need an exec-level summary for your stakeholders, I've included a one-page brief (attached: mutual_action_plan_draft.docx).

I'll keep monitoring and will escalate to our VP of Reliability if we see a regression.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
